title: Strategic roadmap for SMEs implemented by 88% in Azerbaijan | Report.az

facts.fact: Vusal Gasimli, Executive Director of the Center for Analysis and Communication of Economic Reforms, said the strategic roadmap on consumer goods production at the small and medium entrepreneurship level in Azerbaijan for 2016-2021 has been implemented by 88%.
facts.quote: The strategic roadmap on the production of consumer goods on the level of small and medium entrepreneurship in Azerbaijan in 2016-2021 has been implemented by 88%, Executive Director

facts.fact: Gasimli made the 88% implementation remark at a meeting with a delegation led by Deputy Chairman of the Board of KOSGEB (Office for the Support and Development of Small and Medium Industrial Enterprises in Türkiye), Salih Tuna Sahin.
facts.quote: Gasimli made the remark at a meeting with a delegation led by Deputy Chairman of the Board of the Office for the Support and Development of Small and Medium Industrial Enterprises
